documents.title: Указная память о ведании Смоленска и других возвращённых по Андрусовскому миру от Польши городов в Малороссийском приказе. 18 июня 1667 г.

date.note: Old Style date retained; Gregorian equivalent is 28 June 1667.

documents.notes: Implementation evidence that Smolensk and other towns returned under the Andrusovo settlement were placed into Russian administrative jurisdiction. This does not substitute for the treaty text when reconstructing the complete legal border.
